model.note: Base Neptune 4; not Pro, Plus or Max.

bed_size_mm.note: Advertised printable XYZ, not validated export bounds.

max_nozzle_temperature_c.note: Manufacturer capability, not a filament preset.

native_file_formats.note: Neptune 4 series G-code export, not STL/OBJ model import.

official_slicer_name.note: Manufacturer-distributed slicer, not a claim that it is the newest option.

official_slicer_download_url.note: Vendor-owned release linked by the manufacturer guide.

firmware.note: Firmware family not stated on the cited manufacturer page; ZEIM falls back to its model-name guess, else the maker picks the pause command.

notes: Maximum bed temperature and multicolor compatibility omitted pending verification. Missing accessory support means unknown, not none.
